https://martin.kleppmann.com/papers/olep.summary: Sequencing derived effects through a log addresses non-atomic and reordered cross-system writes, while the paper explicitly retains lag and cross-store read-isolation limits.
https://martin.kleppmann.com/papers/olep.limitations: Copyright owner/authors with ACM publication rights; no broad reuse licence. OLEP is not a universal transaction replacement.
https://martin.kleppmann.com/papers/olep.code_actionability: Retain transactional outbox, idempotent at-least-once delivery and rebuildable monitoring projections; no new event bus.
